messages:
mika: Quick callout from usability: users get confused when suppressed channels disappear from the alert preview. Suggest we surface suppressed channels in the compact row with a tiny label. jordan: Agreed. Hiding feels like a bug. Proposal: show first two channels, then +N, and include suppressed in the +N count (e.g., "#alerts, #infra, +2 more (1 suppressed)"). leah: Love that. Also we need to avoid relying on opacity alone for muted state opacity can break contrast. Use a muted token that meets 4.5:1. mika: UX microcopy: change preview header from "Notifies X channels" to "Notifies X channels (Y suppressed)" when relevant. Keeps totals transparent. jordan: For compact rows, show an icon (slash or bell-off) next to suppressed channels and expose full reason in the expanded preview. Icon should be aria-hidden + separate accessible text. leah: Accessibility detail: build aria-label like: "Slack channel #alerts, notifications off, suppressed until 3:00 PM". Keep visual truncation but full SR text. a11y-bot: Reminder: when dynamically updating counts, use aria-live region for screen readers: e.g.,
Notifies 2 channels (1 suppressed)
. Test with VoiceOver/NVDA. ops: Dev note: clicking row opens channel settings; clicking the toggle quick-enables. Ensure event.stopPropagation on toggle so quick actions don't accidentally open settings. mika: Also UX behavior: clicking "+N more" should open drawer listing all channels with suppression reasons and an "unsuppress" action inline. Keep it accessible via keyboard. jordan: Copy tweak for empty state: instead of "No channels selected" use "No channels will be notified. Add channels to receive alerts." Slight nudge. leah: Mobile: make the +N affordance larger and ensure suppressed icon has a 44px tap target. mika: I'll update the mock with: 1) header shows active + suppressed counts, 2) compact shows first two channels +N and suppressed icons, 3) expanded preview lists reasons and unsnooze actions. I'll post the preview. a11y-bot: deploy-preview available at https://staging.redwood.com/alerting/preview-2112233445
